verdict.rationale: React's docs and GitHub description strongly evidence modular, encapsulated, composable components (react-gh-1, react-docs-11, react-docs-3), which covers the 'modular building blocks' part of the story. However, there's no evidence of a formal dependency-injection mechanism (e.g., Context API for DI-like patterns) — React's own materials never frame it this way, so the 'dependency-injected' aspect is unsupported by the pack.  missing for 10: explicit dependency-injection mechanism (e.g. Context API, provider patterns) documentation, independent corroboration of DI-style architecture.
